label.purpose: Paths, IDs, commands and state labels.

motion.name: context-transition
motion.purpose: Explorer context only; reduced motion keeps immediate readable state changes.

components.name: Task selector
components.description: A real keyboard-focusable control for a persisted Task; never a fixture card.

components.name: Version-control tabs
components.description: History and Changes use ARIA relationships and arrow, Home and End keyboard navigation.

components.name: Project context controls
components.description: Only persistent, actionable project and branch controls belong in the topbar.

narrative.overview: ADE is a light-first macOS agentic workbench. Conversations, code changes and decisions are evidence to read and act on, not dashboard decoration. The shell stays calm, accessible and pragmatic: every visible control has a real action, every state has a source, and each panel appears only where it is useful.
keyCharacteristics: Labeled desktop navigation, explorer, terminal and project context.
Warm light default with a distinct ink-blue dark theme.
Flat structural panes, readable metadata and restrained semantic accents.
Task, dialog and tab controls are keyboard-complete.
Heavy editor capabilities load only when requested.

rules.name: Truthful chrome
rules.body: Do not render placeholder tasks, fake health, identity, notifications or controls without an action.

rules.name: Owned surfaces
rules.body: Git workspace belongs to Version control and the documentation graph to Project context; global availability does not justify global placement.

rules.name: Readable adaptation
rules.body: Preserve a 580px workbench reserve and respect reduced motion without hiding the resulting state.

dos: Prefer direct labels over ornamental chrome.
Keep code, conversation and diffs easy to scan.
donts: Do not use generic dashboard cards for operational evidence.
Do not eagerly load optional editor engines.
